description:
Make the wheel and sdist correct under a single-repo model: maintainer
scaffolding (release scripts, _project/, _blog/, drafts, dev-tooling root
files) is excluded from the published artefacts even when those files are
present in the repo on main. This is reversible, internal-only, and safe
to land before the dev locus migration.

Goal: pip install benchbox produces the same package contents whether
installed from a curated public mirror (today) or from the future
single-repo source (post-Phase 4).

This phase's PR is built from the private clone (current dev locus) and
syncs to public via the existing curated-mirror flow as one of its last
uses, OR is bundled into the Phase 4 final sync. Either is fine.

Plan file: /Users/joe/.claude/plans/single-repo-migration.md (Phase 1).

anti_patterns.dont: change the build backend (e.g., setuptools to hatch) as part of this phase
anti_patterns.why: that is a separate decision and would mask whether the exclude changes are working correctly.

anti_patterns.dont: delete any source files in this phase
anti_patterns.why: file deletion is Phase 6; this phase only adjusts what gets packaged.
exclude config errors can produce wheels that build but fail to import (e.g., excluding a package __init__.py); only an actual install proves correctness.

preserves.behavior: Existing release-time CI (automate_release.py) continues to work unchanged - this phase does not touch the release flow.
Existing tests continue to pass unchanged.
The actual benchbox package contents inside the wheel (everything under benchbox/) is unchanged. Only what is alongside it (release scripts, _project, etc.) is now excluded.

verifications.description: Wheel does not contain maintainer scaffolding
Sdist does not contain maintainer scaffolding

work_units.notes:
pyproject.toml lines 57-68 already exclude benchbox.release in the
setuptools config. MANIFEST.in already prunes benchbox/release, tests,
docs, examples (per workflow.py exploration earlier).
Identify the gap: the maintainer scaffolding paths in HOLD_BACK_PATHS
(workflow.py:18-43) that are NOT yet in either file.
work_units.summary: Read current pyproject.toml and MANIFEST.in to see what is already excluded

work_units.notes:
Edit pyproject.toml. Add to [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel] (or
setuptools equivalent depending on what build backend is in use):
  exclude = [ "benchbox/release/**" ]
Add to [tool.hatch.build.targets.sdist] exclude:
  "_project", "_blog", ".claude", ".codex", ".gemini", "_chart_data",
  "release", "scripts/automate_release.py", "scripts/prepare_release.py",
  "scripts/finalize_release.py", "scripts/verify_release.py",
  "scripts/build_release.py", "scripts/sync_repos.py",
  "tests/unit/release/**", "tests/unit/test_release_*.py",
  "todo.config.yaml", "skill-sync.yaml", "skill-sync.lock",
  "_benchbox_pytest_xdist_safety.py", ".pre-commit-config.yaml",
  ".coveragerc_core", ".dockerignore", ".env.example", ".mcp.json",
  "AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md", "GEMINI.md",
  ".mypy_cache", ".ruff_cache", "htmlcov"
These dev-tooling root files (.pre-commit-config.yaml etc.) are
project-level infrastructure that lives on main but should not ship
in published wheels. They land on public in Phase 4 (final sync) but
are excluded from the wheel by this phase's config.
Adapt list based on what actually exists in repo root today.
work_units.summary: Add hatch wheel/sdist excludes for HOLD_BACK_PATHS content not already covered

work_units.notes:
